decisions.reason: The multi-model bleaching tray line sits at the core of the firm's thermoforming range for dental labs and was visibly featured on its own page, so after four years of investment management would keep it and treat any weak sales as temporary.
The PETG blank is a cheap, established addition to the thermoforming portfolio that was given its own page, so there is little pressure to withdraw it and continuing costs little.
Public commitment is lower because the lacquer is only mentioned on the website, but as a low-cost consumable that supports the announced digital workflow it is more likely kept than dropped.

Custom earmolds are central to the firm's custom-device manufacturing identity and represent investment in a multi-model line, which encourages persistence even though the related hearing-protection line was dropped.
